interpretation.claim_limit: The result is a finite-box standard-physics BAO baseline. It cannot establish the target interaction, its posterior, or the CMB-likelihood result.
interpretation.comparison_limit: Any chi-square difference from the prior two-parameter free-alpha screen is descriptive: this CAMB parameterization predicts r_drag and has three finite-box parameters, with massive-neutrino and BBN choices stated above.
interpretation.new_research_question: Does enforcing a physical sound horizon under the target paper's very broad physical-density/thetaMC box leave the BAO-only LambdaCDM fit well identified, or do BAO data alone drive parameters to the search edges?
